Class ItemRows

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.settings.ItemRows
public final class ItemRows extends Object
A list of items in /tempest (API_VERSION 27, shown as one list since 28), for a setting kept as text such as "Ingredient_Bar_Iron x16, Food_Bread x5" or "Crate_Key_Gold, Rock_Gem_Diamond". The menu shows one dropdown that adds an item (type to search) and the items under it, each with a "how many" field when the list has counts and an X that takes it out. 
settings.addAll(ItemRows.of("Milestone item", 6, true, c::getMilestoneItems, c::setMilestoneItems));
The setting stays one text value, so files and the code reading them do not change. Check CoreAPI.runningVersion() >= 27 before using it.
